$comment: Schema property paths we've deliberately decided NOT to track, so the nightly schema-coverage check (scripts/schema_coverage.py) doesn't fail on them. Does NOT affect the per-PR diff — that tracks exactly what the templates define. Only in-scope paths need listing here: top-level ruleset props (e.g. 'id', 'source'), and parameters of rule types our templates use ('rules.<type>.parameters.<param>'). Rule types we DON'T template (merge_queue, tag_name_pattern, ...) are auto-excluded — no need to list them.
